form_title: 2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten. NOTATION: every money cell is written as a hand-drawn '$' followed by '804' and a small raised, underlined cents pair; read as 804.16 at medium confidence (the raised cents are the least crisp element on the page, but the same figure repeats in seven cells). Lines 3 and 7 are slashed-zero glyphs, transcribed '0'. The fax-number cell holds a hand-drawn dash, not a number. The 'For Office Use Only' box carries an UPSIDE-DOWN 'FILED UTAH COUNTY CLERK / AUDITOR 10 JUN 15 PM 1:54' stamp (the clerk stamped the sheet inverted) - cosmetic only. Summary page header reads 'Page 1 of 3'; its Date of Report ('6/14/2010') is used, the cover signature reads '6/14/10'.
